blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The field of Artificial Intelligence (AI) is vastly growing and has been adopted for many application domains. Vision Language Models (VLMs) are one of the recently advanced AI techniques that have been explored to support automotive features such as vehicle perception, planning, and safety assurance. However, such language models are prone to hallucinations, posing a potential threat to the safety of automotive systems that may incorporate them. Within the automotive domain, VLMs could not only hallucinate traffic objects, but could also fail to identify traffic objects that are actually present, which may potentially lead to dangerous situations. Though we have observed a growing body of literature that proposes verification and validation (V&V) techniques for safe and trustworthy AI, these methods are often studied in isolation, focusing either on run-time or design-time phases. Such isolated techniques could be insufficient in safety-critical, realistic contexts such as automotive perception systems. In this paper, we analyze both design-time and run-time verification and validation techniques based on a taxonomy of trustworthiness presented by Huang et al. We present an automotive study in which a design-time qualification workflow is proposed to complement run-time monitoring. This workflow combines a fixed safety-relevant ontology-based structured annotation system together with a synonym-based evaluation process to statistically evaluate three state-of-the-art VLMs against data from the nuScenes dataset. We observed that the proposed technique enables deterministic and repeatable quantification of the hallucinations VLMs generate in automotive perception-related tasks. The proposed workflow supports model comparison and deployment-oriented engineering decisions within the design-time verification and validation process and will contribute to a holistic verification strategy that strives towards trustworthy automotive perception systems.
blocks.zh: 人工智能领域(AI)发展迅速,并被许多应用领域所采用. Vision Language Models(VLMs)是最近被探索的高级AI技术之一,旨在支持汽车特性,如车辆感知,规划和安全保障等. 然而,这种语言模型容易产生幻觉,对可能包含这些幻觉的汽车系统的安全构成潜在威胁. 在汽车领域,VLM不仅可以幻觉出交通物体,而且可能无法识别实际存在的交通物体,这可能导致危险的情况. 尽管我们看到越来越多的文献为安全和可信赖的AI提出了核查和验证(V&V)技术,但这些方法往往被孤立地研究,侧重于运行时间或设计时间阶段。 这种孤立的技术在诸如汽车感知系统等安全关键的现实环境中可能是不够的。 在本文中,我们根据黄等提出的可信赖性分类法,分析设计时间和运行时间的验证和验证技术. 我们提出一项汽车研究,其中提出了设计-时间资格审查工作流程,以补充运行时间监测。 这一工作流程结合了一个基于安全性的固定本体学结构化注解系统,以及一个以同义词为基础的评价过程,以对照nuScens数据集的数据对三种最新VLM进行统计评价. 我们注意到,拟议的技术能够确定和重复量化汽车感知相关任务中产生的幻觉VLM。 拟议工作流程支持设计-时间核查和验证过程中的模型比较和以部署为导向的工程决定,并将有助于制定全面核查战略,努力实现可靠的汽车感知系统。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Modern software systems have benefited from a combination of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Computer Vision (CV), and sensor fusion, which could potentially lead to enhanced
decision-making, perception, and efficiency. The recent developments in the automotive industry increasingly integrate AI components into perception monitoring systems, decision making systems and other driver assistance functionalities enhancing traffic safety and traffic efficiency [ 18 ] . This technological shift tends to embrace end-to-end approaches that include algorithm frameworks, utilizing raw sensor inputs [ 4 ] . Among many other relevant AI techniques, the usage of LLMs for real-time processing of sensor input such as camera footage, LiDAR, and radar in self-driving vehicles has recently gained the attention of the research community in the automotive context [ 29 ] . Vision Language Models (VLMs) are a type of LLMs that work with such multimodal data in various domains that have shown exemplary capabilities in visual input-related tasks, not only limited to image captioning, multi-modal reasoning, and visual question answering [ 7 ] . Henceforth, VLMs are now widely assessed to explore their potential application in automotive contexts to support various tasks such as perception and monitoring tasks, and in-car passenger communication [ 1 ] .
blocks.zh:
现代软件系统受益于人工智能(AI)、计算机视野(CV)和传感器聚变(CV)的组合,这些组合有可能加强
决策、认识和效率。 汽车业最近的发展日益将AI部分纳入感知监测系统、决策系统和其他驾驶员协助功能,以加强交通安全和交通效率[18]。 这种技术转变倾向于包括包括算法框架在内的端到端方法,利用原始传感器输入[4]. 在许多其他相关的AI技术中,使用LLMs实时处理相机镜头等传感器输入,LiDAR,自驾车辆中的雷达,最近获得了汽车背景下的研究界的关注[29]. 视觉语言模型(VLMs)是一类LLMs,在各种领域与这类多模式数据合作,在视觉输入相关任务中表现出了典范能力,不仅仅限于图像字幕,多模式推理,视觉问题回答[7]. 从此以后,VLM现在被广泛评估,探索其在汽车环境下的潜在应用,以支持各种任务,如感知和监测任务,以及乘车旅客通信[1].

blocks.en: 1.1 Problem Domain and Motivation
blocks.zh: 1.1 问题领域和动机

blocks.en: In safety-critical domains, failures of AI components would pose system-level hazards. Though AI components such as VLMs have shown remarkable capabilities in automotive domain-related tasks, the potential risk of hallucinations generated by such models has remained an open challenge. Hallucinations are essentially known as nonsensical or unfaithful information that are generated by LLMs compared to the provided context or real-world knowledge [ 15 ] . Within the automotive context, three types of hallucinations have been mainly identified; where the answer generated by a VLM refers to objects that are not present in the actual context, where the VLM fails to identify objects that are actually present in the context, and instances where the VLM rejects processing the images due to conflicting reasons that are beyond the understanding of the authors [ 6 ] . From the perspective of a software engineer, the stochastic behavior of VLMs that may produce incorrect outputs would challenge traditional verification, testing, and qualification methods [ 23 ] .
blocks.zh: 在安全关键领域,AI组件的故障会造成系统一级的危险。 虽然诸如VLM等AI组件在汽车领域相关任务中表现出了出众的能力,但这种模型产生幻觉的潜在风险仍然是一个公开的挑战. 与所提供的上下文或现实世界的知识相比,幻觉本质上被称为LLMs产生的非感想或不忠实的信息[15]. 在汽车上下文中,已主要识别出三类幻觉;由VLM生成的答案指实际上下文中不存在的物体,VLM未能识别实际上下文中存在的物体,而VLM则因作者无法理解的相冲突原因而拒绝处理图像的情况[6]. 从软件工程师的角度来看, VLMs 产生不正确输出的扭曲行为将挑战传统的核实,测试,和资格认证方法[23].

blocks.en: Recent research has shown interest in detecting and mitigating hallucinations in various contexts such as code generation, question and answer scenarios, and automotive perception tasks [ 20 , 7 ] . Among these methods, the use of LLMs/VLMs as a judge to verify their own outputs [ 20 ] has shown promising potential in detecting hallucinations in real-time evaluations where the ground truth is not present. Such techniques can be considered as run-time-oriented verification techniques [ 16 ] , in which decisions can be made without relying on the ground truth by principle.
blocks.zh: 最近的研究显示,人们有兴趣在诸如代码生成,问答情景,汽车感知任务等各种情况下发现并缓解幻觉[20,7]. 在这些方法中,使用LLM/VLMs作为法官来核实自己的产出[20]显示出在地面真相不存在的实时评价中发现幻觉的有希望的潜力。 此类技术可被视为以时间为导向的核查技术[16],在这种技术中,可以在原则上不依赖实地真相的情况下作出决定。

blocks.en: While such approaches are valuable for detecting failures during operations, the LLMs/VLMs could also occasionally hallucinate when used as judges. Therefore, it is important to introduce a qualification step to guide early-phase engineering decisions and to evaluate existing LLMs/VLMs, with the focus on avoiding the recursive problem of hallucinations [ 39 ] . Such a qualification step would especially be important within safety-critical systems, where architectural and model selection decisions must be made prior to deployment.
blocks.zh: 虽然这类方法对于发现行动失败很有价值,但作为法官使用有限责任公司/自愿终止责任公司有时也会产生幻觉。 因此,必须引入资格认证步骤来指导早期的工程决定并评价现有的LLM/VLM,重点是避免幻觉的递归性问题[39]. 这种资格审查步骤在安全关键系统中尤其重要,在安全关键系统中,必须在部署之前作出建筑和模型选择决定。

blocks.en: 1.2 Research Goal and Research Questions
blocks.zh: 1.2 研究目标和研究问题

blocks.en: Recent taxonomies of the safety and trustworthiness of LLMs establish fundamental differences between design-time (offline) and run-time (online) evaluation techniques [ 16 ] , emphasizing that both techniques are necessary to develop trustworthy AI systems. The design-time evaluation techniques are capable of assessing AI components prior to deployment, supporting model selection decisions, system integration, and risk assessment, whereas run-time evaluation techniques focus on detecting and mitigating potential failures occurring during system operations.
blocks.zh: 近期的LLMS安全和可信赖性分类确定了设计-时间(离线)和运行-时间(上线)评价技术之间的根本区别[16],强调这两种技术对于开发可信赖的AI系统都是必要的. 设计时间评价技术能够在部署前评估AI组件,支持模型选择决定,系统整合和风险评估,而运行时间评价技术则侧重于发现并缓解系统运行过程中可能出现的故障.

blocks.en: In this study, we focus on a design-time verification technique and establish a controlled evaluation framework that follows a statistical approach to systematically evaluate VLMs for potential use within a safety-critical systems. We follow the taxonomy presented by Huang et al. [ 16 ] to discuss existing evaluation techniques that fall under the design-time phase and safeguarding techniques that fall under the run-time monitoring phase. For the run-time evaluation, we implement an existing “LLM-as-a-judge” [ 39 ] verification technique that assess the AI system during run-time, complementing the design-time verification process.
blocks.zh: 在这项研究中,我们侧重于设计-时间核查技术,并建立一个可控评价框架,采用统计方法,系统地评估可用于安全关键系统中的甚高频。 我们遵循由黄等介绍的分类法. [16] 讨论属于设计-时间阶段的现有评价技术和属于运行时间监测阶段的保障技术。 对于运行时间评估,我们采用现有的“LLM-as-a-judge”[39]核查技术,在运行时间评估人工智能系统,补充设计-时间核查过程。

blocks.en: RQ-1 How can design-time verification techniques be used to systematically evaluate hallucination risks of VLMs as a qualification step before deploying them in safety-critical systems to support perception-related tasks? RQ-2 How do existing verification and validation techniques differ in their applicability and limitations when used at design-time compared to run-time in automotive perception systems? RQ-3 What are strengths and limitations of run-time hallucination techniques when considered for complementing design-time verifications? RQ-4 To what extent can a statistically grounded design-time evaluation framework support engineering decisions related to model selection, qualification, and deployment readiness in safety-critical automotive perception tasks?

blocks.en: 1.3 Contributions and Scope
blocks.zh: 1.3 贡献和范围

blocks.en: We discuss existing verification and validation techniques that enable the trustworthiness of an LLM-assisted perception system in both design-time and run-time operations based on the taxonomy proposed by Huang et al. [ 16 ] . We further explore the hallucination detection methods that use LLMs/VLMs to check their own results following the “LLM-as-a-Judge” technique [ 7 ] . The main contribution of this study is the design-time evaluation approach that can be suggested as a qualification step in the process of using LLMs/VLMs within perception monitoring systems for a safety-critical system, for instance, within vehicles. We further investigate how the ethical usage of AI components and falsification and evaluation techniques would complement each other, striving for the trustworthiness of the AI-based software systems. The replication package, including the supplementary materials used for this study, is available on Github .
blocks.zh: 我们讨论了现有的核查和验证技术,这些技术使LLM辅助感知系统在以黄克华等人提议的分类法为基础的设计时间和运行时间操作中都具有可信赖性。 [16]. 我们进一步探索利用LLM/VLM来检查自己结果的幻觉检测方法。 这项研究的主要贡献是设计-时间评价办法,可以建议在诸如车辆内的安全临界系统在感知监测系统内使用LLM/VLM的进程中作为资格步骤。 我们进一步调查AI组件的道德用法以及伪造和评价技术如何相互补充,努力提高基于AI的软件系统的可信度。 复制包,包括本研究所用的补充材料,可在Github查阅。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Verification and validation of AI-based complex software systems have become increasingly important with the adoption of LLM-powered modules. We often see non-deterministic behaviors of such LLM-based modules that challenge the traditional Verification and Validation (V&V) practices [ 22 ] . In safety-critical domains such as the automotive industry, standard guidelines, for instance, ISO/PAS 21448 and ISO 26262 are in place to emphasize systematic qualification and risk reduction [ 17 ] . However, modern Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) and Autonomous Driving (AD) features that utilize VLMs/LLMs fall outside the scope of such standards and guidelines due to their limited concrete guidance on the operationalization of V&V processes [ 30 ] . Therefore, the majority of the existing V&V techniques are largely isolated in engineering workflows in terms of design-time and run-time stages.
blocks.zh: 随着LLM动力模块的采用,基于AI的复杂软件系统的核查和验证变得越来越重要. 我们经常看到这种基于LLM的模块的非决定性行为挑战了传统的核查和验证做法[22]。 在诸如汽车工业等安全关键领域,制定了标准准则,例如ISO/PAS 21448和ISO 26262,强调系统的资格和减少风险[17]。 然而,现代先进驾驶员协助系统(ADS)和自主驾驶(AD)功能使用VLMs/LLMs,由于它们在V&V流程操作方面的具体指导有限而不属于这些标准和准则的范围[30]. 因此,就设计时间和运行时间阶段而言,现有的大多数V&V技术在工程工作流程中基本孤立.

blocks.en: In the related literature, studies showcase various falsification techniques and evaluation tactics for design-time phases of the LLM life cycle. Techniques such as prompt injection can challenge the behavior of an LLM-based system by injecting malicious instructions into the prompt [ 26 ] . Such studies uncover to what extent LLM-based systems can be manipulated during design time. However, there seems to be no universal solution to these issues, for instance, a single methodology or an evaluation protocol that is sufficiently reliable in detecting such manipulations across different models and different domains that utilize multi-modal data.
blocks.zh: 在相关文献中,研究展示了各种伪造技术和评价策略,用于LLM生命周期的设计-时间阶段. 即时注射等技术可以通过将恶意指令注入即时[26]来挑战基于LLM的系统的行为. 这些研究揭示了基于LLM的系统在设计期间可被操纵的程度。 然而,这些问题似乎没有普遍的解决办法,例如,单一方法或评价协议在发现利用多式数据的不同模型和不同领域的操纵行为方面十分可靠。

blocks.en: As a V&V technique, studies that compare AI output with human experts report promising results in evaluating AI modules during their design time [ 13 ] . Most studies exclusively focus on domains that involve only text-based data, narrowing their applicability in automotive industry perception monitoring systems that largely depend on multi-modal data. The most recent studies, such as [ 28 ] , establish a useful foundation in the field of safety assessment for the automotive industry in the age of AI. In addition to that, techniques such as benchmarks [ 5 ] and statistical evaluation methods [ 34 ] are also prominent in V&V processes during design-time stages; however, they are not investigated sufficiently to draw conclusions about their applicability in the automotive context.
blocks.zh: 作为一种V&V技术,将AI输出与人类专家进行比较的研究表明,在AI模块设计期间评价有希望的结果[13]. 大多数研究完全侧重于只涉及文本数据的领域,缩小了这些数据在汽车工业感知监测系统中的适用性,这些系统主要依赖多模式数据。 最近的研究,如[28],为AI时代的汽车工业安全评估领域奠定了有益的基础. 除此之外,基准[5]和统计评价方法[34]等技术在设计阶段的V&V过程中也十分突出;然而,这些技术没有得到充分的调查,无法就其在汽车背景下的适用性得出结论。

blocks.en: “LLM-as-a-judge” techniques have been deemed useful in evaluating LLM/VLM-assisted systems that often apply to run-time environments where the decisions have to be made without having access to ground truth data. The related literature suggests many LLM-based evaluation methods of different functionalities, methodologies, and application domains [ 7 ] . Some of such LLM-based evaluation techniques utilize single models [ 11 ] , whereas some utilize multi-model architectures [ 20 ] . However, the majority of these “LLM-as-a-judge” techniques aim at text-based inputs that may or may not be LLM-generated responses.
blocks.zh: “LLM-as-a-judge”技术被认为有助于评价LLM/VLM协助的系统,这些系统往往适用于在无法获取地面真相数据的情况下必须作出决定的运行时间环境。 相关文献提出了不同功能、方法和应用领域许多基于LLM的评价方法[7]。 其中一些基于LLM的评价技术采用单一模式[11],而有些则采用多模式架构[20]。 然而,这些“LLM-as-a-judge”技术大多旨在提供基于文本的投入,这些投入可能是也可能不是LLM生成的。

blocks.en: The SelfCheckGPT technique presented by Manakul et al. [ 20 ] includes an LLM-based hallucination detection technique that can be used to check LLM-generated responses. The LLM responses are generated multiple times for the same prompt and later used as context to check the consistency of the first response by decomposing it into single sentences. The consistency checking is conducted using LLMs by prompting them with each sentence together with one of the remaining responses to evaluate whether this sentence is supported by the response. The binary answers received for each sentence are recorded to calculate the sentence-wise consistency score. This technique has shown promising results when evaluated against the Wikibio dataset curated by the authors; however, its applicability in other application contexts, for instance, when multi-modal data is involved, has not been addressed.
blocks.zh: 自我检查GPT Manakul等人介绍的技术。 [20]包括基于LLM的幻觉检测技术,可用于检查LLM生成的响应. LLM响应为同一种即时生成多倍,后被用为上下文,通过分解为单句来检查第一个响应的一致性. 一致性检查使用LLMS进行,方法是促使它们与每个句子一起与其余的回复一起评估该句子是否得到回复的支持. 每个句子收到的二进制答案被记录下来,以计算出句法一致性分数. 在对照作者整理的Wikibio数据集进行评价时,这一技术已经显示出有希望的结果;但是,它在其他应用情况下的适用性,例如在涉及多模式数据的情况下,还没有处理。

blocks.en: Sawczyn et al. present a hallucination detection technique named FactSelfCheck [ 31 ] that uses the “LLM-as-a-judge” concept. This technique performs fact-checking using a different LLM to directly test the fact-level information that was in the response. It does not include any sentence-decomposing tasks, but rather the entire fact is represented as a knowledge graph, which is then verified by another LLM. While this method can be adopted to work with multi-modal data, it would not be efficient within a real-time environment, such as automotive, where having an intermediary layer that maps visual data into knowledge triplets would slow down the overall process. In addition to that, having only LLMs as evaluators would introduce the recursive problem of hallucinations as well.
blocks.zh: Sawczyn等人介绍了一种名为FactSelfCheck[31]的幻觉探测技术,该技术采用了“LLM-as-a-judge”概念。 这一技术使用不同的LLM进行事实检查,直接测试答复中的事实层面信息。 它不包括任何句子分解任务,而是将整个事实作为知识图来表示,然后用另一个LLM来验证. 虽然可以采用这种方法来处理多模式数据,但在实时环境中,如汽车公司,如果有一个将视觉数据映射成知识三重体的中间层,则无法高效地完成整个过程。 除此之外,只有法学硕士作为评价员,也会产生幻觉的递归性问题。

blocks.en: Dona et al. [ 7 ] presented an adaptation of SelfCheckGPT that is applicable within the automotive domain to detect hallucinations in perception-related tasks when LLMs are used to detect objects. This approach uses multi-modal data and has been influenced by the CrossCheckGPT technique [ 33 ] . In this technique, the authors have proposed an exclusion criterion, where less consistent sentences, ie., hallucinated content, will be removed from the first response. This method has been evaluated with two state-of-the-art automotive datasets, focusing on further external factors such as weather conditions, lighting conditions, or driving patterns. This technique caters to the automotive domain, detecting and mitigating hallucinations in LLM-assisted perception and monitoring systems.
blocks.zh: 多纳等. [7] 介绍了适用于汽车领域内部的SelfCheckGPT的修改,用于在使用LLMs来检测物体时,在感知相关任务中检测出幻觉. 这种方法使用多式数据,并受到CrossCheckGPT技术的影响[33]. 在这个技术中,作者们提出了一个排除标准,即不太一致的句子,即幻觉内容,将从第一次反应中去掉. 这种方法通过两个最先进的汽车数据集进行了评价,重点是天气条件,照明条件,或驱动模式等进一步的外部因素. 这一技术满足了汽车领域的需求,检测并缓解了LLM辅助感知和监测系统中的幻觉.

blocks.en: 3 Research Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 研究方法

blocks.en: We adopt an empirical methodology to investigate how design-time verification techniques complement run-time monitoring techniques to detect and mitigate hallucinations on the example of an automotive perception system. A taxonomy-guided V&V categorization technique is first used to systematically evaluate the existing V&V techniques that assess the trustworthiness of LLMs within safety-critical systems. This study considers hallucination detection and mitigation as quality assurance and verification processes that span across the run-time and design-time phases of the software engineering life cycle.
blocks.zh: 我们采用了一种经验方法,以调查设计-时间核查技术如何补充运行时间监测技术,以便以汽车感知系统为例发现并缓解幻觉。 一种分类学指导的V&V分类技术首先用于系统地评价评估安全关键系统中LLMs的可信赖性的现有V&V技术。 本研究认为幻觉检测和缓解是贯穿软件工程生命周期运行时间和设计时间阶段的质量保证和核查过程.

blocks.en: 3.1 Taxonomy-based study selection
blocks.zh: 3.1 基于分类学的研究选择

blocks.en: Figure 1 shows the taxonomy proposed by Huang et al. [ 16 ] categorizing V&V techniques onto the LLM lifecycle. For this study, we selectively focused on the categories Falsification and Evaluation, Verification, Run-time Monitoring, and Regulations and Ethical Use, and the respective V&V techniques that fall under them (cf. Figure. 2 ). The studies presented in [ 16 ] have been categorized under the taxonomy below and were analyzed further to understand their application domain, modality of the data, and limitations. The following sections reproduce and summarize essential parts from the study by Huang et al. [ 16 ] .
blocks.zh: 图1显示了黄来等人提出的分类法. [16]将V&V技术分类到LLM生命周期. 就这项研究而言,我们有选择地侧重于伪造和评估、核查、运行时间监测、规章和道德使用等类别,以及属于这些类别的各个脆弱性和适应技术(见图)。 [16]中介绍的研究按以下分类法分类,并作进一步分析,以了解其应用领域、数据模式和局限性。 以下各节转载并总结了黄等的研究要点. [16].

blocks.en: Falsification and Evaluation
blocks.zh: 伪造和评价

blocks.en: The verification techniques that identify and evaluate the scenarios where LLMs actively fail, posing benign or malignant risks, fall under this category [ 16 ] . The prompt injection techniques [ 26 ] , comparisons with human experts [ 13 ] , evaluations against benchmark datasets [ 37 ] , and testing and statistical evaluations are some V&V techniques that are identified.
blocks.zh: 确定和评估有限责任管理办法积极失败、造成良性或恶性风险的假设情况的核查技术属于这一类[16]。 快速注射技术[26],与人类专家的比较[13],对照基准数据集进行的评价[37],以及测试和统计评价,是一些被确定的V&V技术.

blocks.en: Verification
blocks.zh: 核查

blocks.en: The techniques that evaluate LLMs based on Natural Language Processing (NLP) approaches are categorized under this category. Verification based on NLP models [ 12 ] , blackbox verification [ 38 ] , robustness evaluation on LLMs, and use of smaller models are some relevant V&V techniques.
blocks.zh: 根据自然语言处理方法评价法学硕士的技术归入这一类别。 基于NLP模型的核查[12],黑盒核查[38],对LLMs的稳健性评价,以及使用更小的模型,是一些相关的V&V技术.

blocks.en: Run-time Monitoring
blocks.zh: 运行时间监测

blocks.en: The run-time evaluation processes provide monitoring techniques to secure LLMs while they interact with the end users [ 16 ] . Monitoring Out-of-Distribution (ODD) scenarios, attacks, and output failures are some common V&V techniques that can be considered as runtime monitoring [ 16 ] .
blocks.zh: 运行时间评价程序提供监测技术,在与终端用户互动时保障LLMS的安全[16]. 监测扩散外(ODD)情景,攻击,和输出故障是一些常见的V&V技术,可以视为运行时间监测[16].

blocks.en: Regulations and Ethical Use
blocks.zh: 条例和道德使用

blocks.en: Technical means for run-time and design-time monitoring are becoming insufficient to verify and validate ever-growing, AI-based, complex systems. The technical aspects must be complemented by ethical means to ensure that AI-based systems align with human principles and values. Decisions related to regulations, implementation of AI acts, Agreements on responsible AI principles, and Educational Challenges are some of the aspects that need to be covered to regulate complex AI systems while ensuring ethical usage [ 14 , 16 ] .
blocks.zh: 运行时间和设计时间监测的技术手段越来越不足以核查和验证不断增加的基于AI的复杂系统。 技术方面必须辅之以道德手段,以确保基于AI的系统符合人的原则和价值观。 有关条例、实施大赦国际法案、关于负责任的大赦国际原则的协议以及教育挑战的决定,是管理复杂的大赦国际制度,同时确保道德使用的一些需要涵盖的方面[14、16]。

blocks.en: Based on the above taxonomy, we select two complementary classes for our study: (a) design-time statistical evaluation and (b) run-time self-checking approaches covering the engineering lifecycle of LLM-based complex systems.
blocks.zh: 基于上述分类法,我们选择两个补充类来进行研究:(a) 设计-时间统计评价;和(b) 涵盖基于LLM的复杂系统的工程生命周期的运行时间自查方法。

blocks.en: 3.2 Design-Time Statistical Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.2 设计-时间统计评价

blocks.en: The proposed evaluation technique strives to assess a model’s proneness to hallucinate before the deployment of the AI component. The VLMs are considered black boxes, and their behavioral stability and the consistency of the outputs are recorded for perception monitoring tasks. The experiment pipeline is outlined in Figure 3 . We curated an image set using nuScenes [ 2 ] , a widely accepted dataset in the automotive context due to its realistic and comprehensive multi-modal image and sensor data. The selected images were used as input to the three VLMs (GPT4o and GPT4.5-preview, and LLaVA (llava:latest 8dd30f6b0cb1)) with a prompt that included predefined rules. VLM responses were recorded and statistically analyzed against the ground truth to answer the research questions.
blocks.zh: 拟议的评价技术力求在部署人工智能部分之前评估模型易产生幻觉的可能性。 VLM被认为是黑匣子,其行为稳定性和输出的一致性被记录下来用于感知监测任务. 图3概述了试验管道。 我们使用nuScenes[2]来管理一个图像集,这是汽车上下文中广为接受的数据集,因为它是现实和全面的多模式图像和传感器数据。 所选取的图像被作为输入三个VLM(GPT4o和GPT4.5-preview,和LLaVA(lava:latest 8dd30f6b0cb1)),并带有包含预定义规则的提示. 已记录了自愿活动清单答复,并根据地面真相进行了统计分析,以回答研究问题。

blocks.en: Dataset Curation
blocks.zh: 数据集校正

blocks.en: nuScenes [ 2 ] is a widely adopted benchmark dataset that provides diverse urban driving scenarios curated for automotive domain-related research. This dataset contains 1000 scenes that were collected in Boston, USA, and Singapore, focusing on diverse locations and driving patterns. Each scene is 20s long and covers high traffic density, rare classes, and maneuvers [ 2 ] . The dataset provides annotations for 23 classes.
blocks.zh: nuScens [2]是一个被广泛采用的基准数据集,为汽车领域相关研究提供了多种城市驱动情景. 本数据集收录了在美国波士顿和新加坡收集的1000个场景,主要关注不同的地点和驱动模式. 每个场景长度为20多分,覆盖了高密度的交通密度,罕见的等级,以及动作[2]. 该数据集为23个班提供了说明.

blocks.en: For our experiment, we curated a subset of 1000 images from nuScenes, focusing on right-hand traffic scenes collected in Boston. The selected subset of images contained images captured during the day by the vehicle front camera. Given the annotation inaccuracies reported in relevant literature [ 3 , 36 ] , the curated dataset was manually annotated to record object labels as ground truth.
blocks.zh: 为了我们的实验,我们整理了来自nuScens的1000个图像的子集, 专注于波士顿收集的右手交通场景。 选定的图像子集包含白天被车辆前相机捕获的图像. 鉴于相关文献[3,36]中报告的注释不准确,所整理的数据集被手动附加了注释,将对象标签记录为地面真理.

blocks.en: Data Collection
blocks.zh: 数据收集

blocks.en: As depicted in the experimental pipeline (cf. Figure 3 ), the curated subset of data was fed into three VLMs with a pre-defined prompt. We used two proprietary VLMs: GPT4o [ 25 ] and GPT4.5-preview [ 24 ] , and one locally executable open VLM, Large Language-and-Vision Assistant (LLaVA) [ 19 ] . Each VLM was tested with the following prompt to identify the objects in each image.
blocks.zh: 如实验管道所描述的(参见图3),被整理的数据子集被输入到三个VLM中,并预设了快取. 我们使用了两个专有的VLM:GPT4o [25]和GPT4.5-审查 [24],以及一个本地可执行的开放式VLM,大型语言和视觉助理(LLaVA) [19]. 每个VLM都用以下的快取来测试,以识别每个图像中的对象.

blocks.en:
You are analyzing a traffic scene image for automotive perception.
Predefined relevant objects: car, bus, truck, bicycle, motorcycle,
pedestrian, traffic light (red, green, yellow).

预定的相关物体:汽车、公共汽车、卡车、自行车、摩托车、

blocks.en: We focus on the most common and most relevant objects for traffic safety by enforcing a set of rules as a guide for the VLM. The annotators also followed the same set of rules during the manual annotation process to generate ground truth object labels. The VLM responses for each image were recorded and later processed with an automated text-matching process against the ground truth to evaluate the VLM performance.

blocks.en: A custom tool was created to manually annotate the objects that are visible in each image. The objects visible were structured and used as ground truth during the VLM response evaluation phase. The annotation process was conducted by two human annotators, who independently worked on half of the dataset each. The annotators cross-validated each other’s labels as the second step, where the inter-rater agreement was calculated based on Cohen’s kappa [ 21 ] . We report a value of 1 for Cohen’s kappa, indicating high reliability levels between the decisions made by two annotators.

blocks.en: 3.3 Run-time Monitoring as a Complementary Baseline
blocks.zh: 3.3 作为补充基线的运行时间监测

blocks.en: As the last step of the analysis, a comparison was conducted between one of the LLM-as-a-judge techniques presented by Dona et al. [ 7 ] to understand how the proposed methodology can be supplemented by run-time safeguarding techniques to improve the trustworthiness of VLMs in safety-critical perception tasks.
blocks.zh: 作为分析的最后一步,对Dona等人提出的一种LLM-as-a-judge技术进行了比较。 [7] 了解如何用跑时保护技术来补充拟议的方法,以提高VLM在安全关键感知任务中的可信赖性.

blocks.en: We implemented the SelfCheckGPT adaptation presented by Dona et al. [ 7 ] as a baseline, using the same subset of images that were retrieved from the nuScenes dataset. We used LLaVA as the captioner model and GPT4o as the checker model. The captioner model was prompted with each image five times to record the traffic objects that are visible. The first response was passed to the checker LLM, with one other response to check whether the first response is supported by the context response. Similarly, the first response of each image was checked against all four remaining responses, and the results were recorded.
blocks.zh: 我们实施了多纳等人提出的自我检查GPT调整。 [7]作为基线,使用从nuScens数据集取回的同一组图像. 我们使用LLaVA作为字幕模型,GPT4o作为检查模型. 标注器模型被提示每个图像五次,以记录可见的交通物体. 第一个响应被传递给检查器LLM,还有一个响应来检查第一个响应是否得到上下文响应的支持. 同样,对每个图像的第一个答复与所有其余四个答复进行了核对,并记录了结果。

blocks.en: The checker LLM responses were analyzed to determine the hallucinated responses based on the consistency level score. The responses with an average consistency larger than 0.5 were considered as non-hallucinated responses. Though the original approach decomposes paragraphs into sentences for the consistency check, it was not directly applicable in this case, where we dealt with a list of objects in the majority of the responses. Following the metrics proposed by Dona et al. [ 7 ] , we treat correct responses as the positive class, whereas the consistent SelfCheck judgments are treated as positive predictions. Therefore, we consider True Positives (TP) as non-hallucinated responses flagged as non-hallucinated, False Positives (FP) as hallucinated responses flagged as non-hallucinated, True Negatives (TN) as hallucinated responses flagged as hallucinated, and False Negatives (FN) as non-hallucinated responses flagged as hallucinated.
blocks.zh: 对检查器LLM响应进行了分析,以根据一致性水平分数确定幻觉响应. 平均一致性大于0.5的回复被视为无卤化物回复。 虽然原始方法将段落分解为一致性检查的句子,但在此情况下并不直接适用,因为在多数答复中,我们处理了一个对象清单。 遵循多纳等人提出的衡量标准。 [7],我们把正确的反应作为正数类,而一致的自查判断则作为正数预测. 因此,我们认为,真阳性反应是标记为无卤化物的非卤化反应,假阳性反应是标记为无卤化物的幻觉反应,真阴性反应是标记为幻觉的幻觉反应,假阴性反应是标记为幻觉的非卤化反应。

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: We report the results of the experiment under three main categories as shown in Table 1 . A perfect match percentage is when the VLM is able to identify all objects correctly without a single hallucination. The open model LLaVA reports 7.8% perfect matches, whereas it is higher, respectively 22.90% and 28.70% for proprietary models GPT4o and GPT4.5-preview. However, the second category indicates relatively higher values for all three models, where the focus was on indicating the extent to which the VLM output contained hallucinations. 92.20% of LLaVA generated responses contained at least one hallucination, whereas it was respectively 77.10% and 71.30% for GPT4o and GPT4.5-preview. The normalized hallucination ratio was calculated as defined in Equation 3 . LLaVA yielded a higher hallucination rate of 73.30%, where GPT4o and GPT4.5-preview displayed normalized hallucination rates of 50.78% and 41.03%, respectively. The last two rows of Table 1 group the deviations in VLM responses under two error categories. The first category includes the number of instances where the VLM response contained a hallucinated traffic object that was not present in the ground truth. The second category represents the number of VLM responses where traffic entities were overlooked, but were reported to be visible in the image according to the ground truth.
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,我们按三个主要类别报告试验结果。 一个完美的匹配百分比是当VLM能够在没有单一幻觉的情况下正确识别出所有物体. 开放式模型LLaVA报告7.8%的完美匹配率,而专利模型GPT4o和GPT4.5-审查率分别为22.90%和28.70%。 然而,第二类显示所有三种模型的数值相对较高,其重点是说明VLM输出包含幻觉的程度. 92.20%的LLaVA生成了至少包含一种幻觉的反应,而GPT4o和GPT4.5-预检结果分别为77.10%和71.30%。 正常幻觉比是按方程式3的定义计算出来的。 LLaVA的幻觉率较高,为73.30%,其中GPT4o和GPT4.5-预览显示的幻觉正常率分别为50.78%和41.03%. 表1后两行将VLM回复中的偏差归为两个出错类别. 第一类包括VLM响应中包含地面真相中不存在的幻觉交通物体的事例. 第二类是被忽略的交通实体的VLM响应次数,但据报告,根据地面真相,这些响应在图像中可见.

blocks.en: We conducted a Shapiro-Wilk test [ 32 ] to determine whether the data samples collected were normally distributed or not. P-values that are lower than the significance level were recorded for all three models.
blocks.zh: 我们进行了一次Shapiro-Wilk测试[32],以确定所收集的数据样本是否正常分布。 所有三种模型都记录了低于意义级的P-值.

blocks.en: A Friedman test [ 10 ] was conducted to understand whether the statistical difference is significant between the related groups (cf. Table 2 . The inputs for this test were the image subset and a data matrix of 3 columns that included the results generated by the three models.
blocks.zh: 进行了一项Friedman测试[10],以了解有关群体之间的统计差异是否显著(见表2)。 这次测试的投入是图像子集和由3个列组成的数据矩阵,其中包括由这3个模型产生的结果.

blocks.en: Table 2: The results of the Friedman test indicate the significance of the statistical difference of the non-normalized data.
blocks.zh: 表2:弗里德曼测试的结果显示非正统数据统计差异的意义.

blocks.en: Kendall W effect size calculation test [ 35 ] was conducted on the results collected from the Friedman test to quantify the magnitude of the observed differences. We recorded an effect size of 0.3987 from this calculation.
blocks.zh: 肯德尔 对从弗里德曼测试中收集到的结果进行了W效应大小计算测试[35],以量化所观测到的差异的大小. 我们从这一计算中记录到效果大小为0.3987.

The entire experiment was executed twice to verify the stability and reliability of the results, and the results are reported in the second and third columns of the table.

blocks.en: In addition to that, the average response time was recorded across a sample size of ten prompts for each VLM as six seconds. The measured response time indicates that the SelfCheck configuration is not yet ideal for time-critical control loop decision systems unless better-performing small local models are deployed within more powerful hardware infrastructure.
blocks.zh: 除此之外,平均响应时间记录在每VLM的样本尺寸为10个正弦上为6秒. 测量的响应时间表明,SelfCheck配置对于时间紧迫的控制循环决策系统来说尚不理想,除非在更强大的硬件基础设施内部署性能更好的局部小模型.

blocks.en: 5 Analysis and Discussion
blocks.zh: 5. 分析和讨论

blocks.en: We first addressed RQ-1 by systematically evaluating VLM responses to detect hallucinations. The results show that the proprietary models GPT4o and GPT4.5-Preview were less hallucinating compared to the open model LLaVA. However, it was noted that all three models were considerably hallucinating, where most of the images resulted in receiving hallucinated responses. When error categories were analyzed, it was noted that all models tend to overlook objects rather than hallucinate new objects, which has a critical impact in automotive application scenarios. We conducted further statistical analysis to check whether the deviations in hallucination detection were not random. The results of the Shapiro-Wilk analysis revealed that the data we collected do not follow a Gaussian distribution. Hence, a Friedman test was conducted to derive the statistical significance of the collected data. The lower Friedman p-values indicated that the changes between the models are statistically significant, reflecting that the performances across models are not random. This led to the rejection of the null hypothesis H 0 H_{0} . However, neither the magnitude of the significance nor the effect is implied by these statistical tests. Based on the further Kendall W effect size test we conducted, we could conclude that our experiment only has a moderate effect size, which could not have impacted the p-value much.
blocks.zh: 我们首先通过系统评估VLM反应来检测幻觉,从而解决了RQ-1. 结果显示,与开放式模型LLaVA相比,专有模型GPT4o和GPT4.5-Preview的幻觉较少. 然而,据指出,这三种模型都具有相当的幻觉,大多数图像都导致收到了幻觉反应. 在分析出出错类别时,有人指出,所有模型都倾向于忽略物体,而不是幻觉出出新物体,这对汽车应用情景具有关键的影响. 我们进行了进一步的统计分析,以检查幻觉检测中的偏差是否是随机的. Shapiro-Wilk分析的结果显示,我们收集的数据并不遵循高斯分布. 因此,进行了弗里德曼测试,以了解所收集数据的统计意义。 较低的弗里德曼p-值表示模型之间的变化在统计学上是显著的,反映了跨模型的性能并不是随机的. 这导致了对无效假设H 0 H_{0}的否定. 然而,这些统计测试既没有暗示意义的程度,也没有暗示影响。 根据我们进一步进行的肯德尔W效应尺寸测试,我们可以得出结论,我们的实验只有中度效应尺寸,这不会对p值产生多大影响.

blocks.en: The statistical approach proposed in this study includes a synonym check and a comparison using regular expressions to evaluate the VLM results with the ground truth. Therefore, this technique can be used during the design time to verify and validate the LLMs/VLMs, assisting engineers to systematically identify better models for perception-related tasks within safety-critical systems and make informed integration decisions.
blocks.zh: 本研究提出的统计方法包括同义词检查和用正则表达式来评价VLM结果与地心真理的比较. 因此,这种技术可以在设计期间用于验证和验证LLM/VLM,协助工程师在安全关键系统中系统地确定更好的与感知有关的任务模型并作出知情的整合决定.

blocks.en: To answer RQ-2 , we systematically analyzed the existing V&V techniques under the taxonomy presented by Huang et al. [ 16 ] . Our findings confirm that the majority of the evaluation techniques are standalone in either design-time or run-time, addressing different validation needs. In addition to that, our analysis reveals that there are only a handful of V&V techniques that focus on either safety-critical domains such as automotive applications or use multi-modal data, allowing validation of VLMs as well [ 28 , 5 ] . The limitations identified through these studies reflect that verification and validation of LLM-based systems should be approached through the holistic life cycle of the AI component, starting from the design time itself. More studies should focus on V&V techniques catered for automotive systems where pre-deployment evidence is critical to make well-informed decisions to better prepare for run-time monitoring.
blocks.zh: 为了回答RQ-2,我们系统地分析了黄等提出的分类法下的现有V&V技术. [16]. 我们的调查结果证实,大多数评价技术在设计时间或运行时间上是独立的,满足不同的验证需要。 除此之外,我们的分析还表明,只有少数V&V技术侧重于诸如汽车应用等安全关键领域,或使用多式数据,从而能够验证VLM以及[28,5]。 通过这些研究查明的局限性表明,对基于LLM的系统的核查和验证应当从设计时间本身开始,通过AI部分的整体生命周期来处理。 更多的研究应侧重于针对汽车系统的V&V技术,在这些系统中,部署前证据对于作出知情决定以更好地准备运行时间监测至关重要。

blocks.en: We addressed RQ-3 by implementing the SelfCheckGPT adaptation proposed by Dona et al. [ 7 ] . The results show higher precision and specificity values, indicating fewer false positives (FP). The lower recall values are a result of higher false negatives, indicating that many non-hallucinated objects were reported as hallucinations. The balanced accuracy field takes both TP and TN into account and reports moderately positive results for the SelfCheckGPT adaptation technique. The method works at the expense of mislabeling many responses as hallucinations, which should be addressed in future studies. While the method demonstrates that it is in principle applicable for hallucination detection as an LLM-as-a-judge technique, which works during run-time, it is adamant that there should be a qualification step to assess the VLMs/LLMs rather than relying on a run-time evaluation technique.
blocks.zh: 我们通过执行多纳等人提出的自我检查GPT适应方案,处理了RQ-3问题。 [7]. 结果显示精度和特异性值较高,表明假阳性(FP)较少. 较低的召回值是假负数较高的结果,表明许多未卤化物被报告为幻觉. 平衡的准确性领域既考虑到TP又考虑到TN, 并报告自检GPT适应技术的中度积极成果。 该方法以错误地将许多反应贴上幻觉为代价而起作用,在未来的研究中应该解决这个问题. 虽然该方法表明,它原则上适用于作为在运行期间起作用的LLM-as-a-judge技术的幻觉检测,但它坚持认为,应当有一个评估VLMs/LLMs的资格步骤,而不是依赖运行时间评价技术。

blocks.en: RQ-4 Compared to the LLM-as-a-judge technique, the statistical approach showed higher performance in terms of accuracy. However, since these techniques are fundamentally applicable in different stages of the LLM-based system life-cycle, a verification and validation pipeline that consists of both techniques could enhance the trustworthiness of AI-enabled complex systems. By relying only on “LLM-as-a-judge” techniques, we may open a recursive problem of VLMs/LLMs hallucinating even when they are employed as a judge. While the significance of such hallucination detection techniques is quite notable, especially since they can be executed in real-time environments without relying on ground truth data, the value of statistically grounded evaluation techniques is also important in instances where ground truth is available to process. Therefore, applying a statistical approach as a design-time step could help the VLM/LLM safeguarding process significantly.
blocks.zh: RQ-4 与LLM-as-a-judge技术相比,统计方法在准确性方面表现较高. 然而,由于这些技术从根本上适用于基于LLM的系统生命周期的不同阶段,由两种技术组成的核查和验证管道可以提高AI驱动的复杂系统的可信赖性。 仅依靠“LLM-as-a-judge”技术,即使担任法官,我们也可能会出现VLM/LLMs产生幻觉的递归问题。 虽然这种幻觉探测技术的重要性相当显著,特别是因为这些技术可以在不依赖地面真相数据的情况下在实时环境中实施,但是在有地面真相可供处理的情况下,基于统计的评价技术的价值也很重要。 因此,采用统计方法作为设计-时间步骤,可以大大地帮助VLM/LLM保障进程。

blocks.en: For VLM-based perception modules to be integrated as a safety component, they should comply with the EU AI Act’s high - risk classification rules (Art. 6) [ 8 ] . In that case, model providers must satisfy the Chapter III requirements, which are usually operationalized through documented evaluations and monitoring of the work products. Our evaluation framework for VLM-assisted vehicle perception acts as a controlled, statistically grounded falsification and verification step. This contribution is significant within the LLM/VLM lifecycle because, in the EU AI Act, these expectations are formalized through requirements on continuous risk management, dataset governance, technical documentation and logging, transparency to deployers, human oversight, accuracy/robustness, and post-market monitoring (Articles 9–15 and 72) [ 8 ] . Our framework’s outcomes can help operationalize the relevant AI Act obligations in practice (evaluation protocols, quantified reliability bounds, and failure-mode taxonomies). This supports accountable model selection and informs deployment constraints and run-time monitoring. Moreover, the framework also operationalizes core Trustworthy AI requirements identified by the AI HLEG [ 14 ] , such as technical robustness and safety, transparency, accountability, and human agency, by converting ethical principles into measurable evaluation criteria.
blocks.zh: 为了将基于VLM的感知模块作为一个安全部分加以整合,它们应当遵守欧盟AI法的高风险分类规则(第6条)[8]. 在这种情况下,模型提供者必须满足第三章的要求,这些要求通常通过对工作产品的有文件记载的评价和监测加以操作。 我们的甚高频辅助车辆感知评价框架是一个有控制、有统计依据的伪造和核查步骤。 这种贡献在LLM/VLM生命周期中具有重大意义,因为在欧盟AI法中,通过对持续风险管理、数据集治理、技术文件和记录、对部署者的透明度、人的监督、准确性/不稳定性以及市场后监测的要求,这些期望得到正式确定(第9至15和72条)。 [8]. 我们的框架结果可以帮助将相关的AI Act义务(评价协议、量化的可靠性界限和故障模式分类)在实践中付诸实施。 这支持负责任的模式选择,并告知部署方面的制约因素和运行时间监测。 此外,该框架还将道德原则转化为可衡量的评价标准,从而落实了国际法高专[14]所确定的值得信赖的核心AI要求,如技术稳健性和安全性、透明度、问责制和人力机构。

blocks.en: We assessed the threats to validity based on Feldt and Magazinius [ 9 ] . In the initial dataset curation process, we limited the number of images to 1000 to keep the processing time at a reasonable length. In addition to that, considering the prior work done by Dona et al. [ 7 ] on lighting conditions on images, we limited the diversity of our dataset by selecting only the daytime-captured images, which do not include adverse weather conditions. This would have narrowed the scope of the current study.
blocks.zh: 我们根据Feldt和Magazinius[9]评估了对有效性的威胁。 在最初的数据集校正过程中,我们把图像的数量限制在1000个,以保持合理的处理时间. 此外,考虑到多纳等人以前所做的工作。 [7] 关于图像的照明条件,我们通过只选择白天捕获的图像来限制我们数据集的多样性,这些图像不包括不利的天气条件. 这将缩小目前研究的范围。

blocks.en: Prompt programming is an important step in supporting the VLM/LLMs in generating accurate and relevant outputs of high quality. Though the final prompt we used for the experiments was obtained heuristically, given the scope of the study, we did not include further experiments on various other prompting techniques. The results of the experiments could significantly vary depending on external factors such as different model architectures, training datasets, etc. We adopted three different off-the-shelf VLMs to increase the diversity of the experiment pipeline with the intention of reducing potential inhibitors for generalization. However, we acknowledge that the results may suffer in generalizability given the unknown nature of the training data these models have been exposed to.
blocks.zh: 快速编程是支持VLM/LLMs产生准确而相关的高质量产出的一个重要步骤. 虽然我们用来进行实验的最后的速率是用高血压得到的,但鉴于研究的范围,我们没有包括其他各种速率技术的进一步试验。 实验结果可能因不同模型架构,培训数据集等外部因素而相去甚远. 我们采用了三种不同现成的VLM来增加实验管的多样性,目的是减少通化的潜在抑制剂. 然而,我们承认,由于这些模型所接触的培训数据的性质不明,结果可能普遍受到影响。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: Modern VLMs have found their way into the automotive domain due to their exceptional capabilities in processing multi-modal data, which will potentially lead to improved ADAS functions for autonomous systems. In this work, we investigate the roles of design-time and run-time V&V techniques that can be applied to safety-critical automotive perception systems. We systematically analyzed the performance of three VLMs (GPT4o, GPT4.5-preview, and LLaVA) to understand to what extent these models hallucinate when they are being used for traffic object identification tasks. Due to the non-deterministic behavior we observed in VLM-based perception systems, we put forward the argument that run-time or design-time hallucination mitigation techniques alone are not sufficient to guarantee the trustworthiness of the perception-based systems.
blocks.zh: 现代的VLM由于在处理多式数据方面的特异能力而进入了汽车领域,这有可能导致自主系统的ADAS功能得到改进. 在这项工作中,我们调查了设计时间和运行时间V&V技术的作用,这些技术可以被应用于安全关键汽车感知系统. 我们系统地分析了三个VLM(GPT4o,GPT4.5-preview,和LLaVA)的性能,以了解这些模型在用于交通物体识别任务时会产生多大的幻觉. 由于我们在基于VLM的感知系统中观察到的非定型行为,我们提出的论点是,单靠运行时间或设计时间的幻觉减缓技术不足以保证感知体系的可信赖性.

blocks.en: In the proposed approach, we focus on a design-time statistical evaluation approach with a run-time monitoring approach that uses an “LLM-as-a-judge” technique to detect hallucinations. However, considering the run-time hallucination detection requirements that persist within vehicles when VLMs are used to extend or complement perception stacks in Advanced Driver Assistant Systems (ADAS), LLM-as-a-judge techniques would fit better, given that they work without being dependent on ground truth data to spot hallucinations. The proposed statistical approach is applicable as a design-time evaluation technique within VLM safeguarding processes, where the ground truth is available. The selection of better-fitting VLMs for perception tasks can be based on the proposed approach.
blocks.zh: 在拟议办法中,我们侧重于设计-时间统计评价办法,采用 " 即审即决的LLM " 技术来检测幻觉。 然而,考虑到车辆内在使用VLM来扩展或补充高级驾驶助理系统(ADS)中的感知堆时持续存在的运行时间幻觉探测要求,LLM-as-a-judge技术将更适合使用,因为这些技术不依赖地面真实数据来发现幻觉。 拟议的统计方法作为设计-时间评价技术,在具有基本真相的自愿终止妊娠保护程序中适用。 选择更适合感知任务的VLM可以采用所提议方法.

blocks.en: We observed that statistical approaches produce deterministic scores in evaluating VLM outputs. All models we used for our experiments hallucinated quite often, regardless of whether they are open models or proprietary models. The proprietary models were less often hallucinating compared to the open models. The proposed statistical evaluation approach can be considered a safety sandbox where the candidate VLMs should be checked before deployment into autonomous systems as decision-making assistants and judges to analyze their own results.
blocks.zh: 我们注意到,统计方法在评价自愿产出方面产生了决定性的分数。 我们用于实验的所有模型都经常产生幻觉, 不管它们是开放模型还是专利模型。 与开放式模型相比,专利模型的幻觉较少. 拟议的统计评价方法可被视为一个安全沙盒,在将候选人的自愿多数人员部署到自主系统之前,应对其进行检查,作为决策助理和法官分析他们自己的结果。

blocks.en: When analyzing the error categories, we identify that the overlooked traffic agents would pose a severe threat to automotive applications, as they could lead to fatal accidents and collisions where the VLM does not recognize the traffic entities that are actually present in the real environment. The statistical approach we presented allows us to identify the tasks that VLMs underperform and, henceforth, reveal the need for additional safeguarding sandboxes in automotive applications.
blocks.zh: 在分析错误类别时,我们发现被忽略的交通代理商会对汽车的应用构成严重威胁,因为它们可能导致致命事故和相撞,而VLM却不承认实际存在于真实环境中的交通实体. 我们提出的统计方法使我们得以确定脆弱LM未能完成的任务,并由此表明在汽车应用中需要更多保护沙盒。

blocks.en: While we present this approach emphasizing the need for having V&V techniques in both design and run-time stages in the VLM safeguarding process, there are many other fields that need to be researched to improve the overall quality of VLM/LLM-assisted perception systems. Further studies are required to handle Out-of-Distribution objects or scenarios where the focused group of objects should be increased compared to the experimental setup of this study. Use of other sensor data, such as LiDAR and radar, would greatly impact this research direction. In addition to that, scaling the models and identifying smaller models with higher performance would be a promising research direction for future studies, which could help the autonomous vehicle domain.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们提出这一办法,强调在VLM保障过程的设计阶段和运行时间阶段都需要V&V技术,但还需要研究许多其他领域,以提高VLM/LLM辅助感知系统的整体质量。 需要作进一步研究,以处理与本研究的实验设置相比,应增加重点物体组的分布外物体或情况。 使用其他传感器数据,如LiDAR和雷达,将极大地影响这一研究方向。 除此之外,扩大模型和确定性能较高的较小模型将是未来研究的一个有希望的研究方向,这可能有助于自主车辆领域。
